scope: Targeted primary-source follow-up for shell and toroidal visual motifs; not an exhaustive priority search.

sources.title: Some simple chaotic flows
sources.reviewed: Pages R647-R648: introduction, search protocol and Table I, especially Cases O and P. Author equation list also checked at https://sprott.physics.wisc.edu/simplest.htm.
sources.finding: Established quadratic three-variable continuous flows. Their equations are not the displayed posterior/reflection recurrence; this does not exclude nonlinear conjugacy.

sources.title: Poincare sections for a new three-dimensional toroidal attractor
sources.finding: Existing genus-three toroidal flow and genus-one symmetry image; toroidal geometry is not itself new.

sources.title: Topology of toroidal chaos. A first step.
sources.reviewed: Complete one-page author poster; Li equations, original/image portraits, section schematic, return map, template matrices and conclusion.
sources.finding: A toroidal appearance can hide an established Rossler-related template after symmetry reduction. No topology or template has been certified for our discrete clouds, so that equivalence remains open.
